scope: Supplemental fresh-process repeat of all eighteen 20M family/build/error and forty-eight nonlinear shape/build/error cases. Same frozen executable, immutable inputs, complete original-input and callback checks, corpora, trial order, warmup and measurement protocol. Four in-process trials per variant and uniform/hot exact and uniform shape corpus. Main-run drift and hot regressions remain relevant; no library adoption or significant-speedup claim.
